narrative: Field's second volume open at the death of John of Gaunt. A trencher pushed to the corner. No foul sheet of verse beside it. The margin has a short pencil mark and no line of the island.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Marked the column, and closed nothing into verse.
